issues.title: Ambiguous Rollback Trigger in Handoff
issues.why: AC-17 and 05-handoff describe rollback, but it's unclear how the detached worker signals the parent to rollback if the parent has already exited or is blocking on a failed process.
issues.fix: Explicitly define the exit code contract between worker and parent to trigger the rename-back logic.

issues.title: Missing Unit for Cleanup Latency
issues.why: AC-16 mentions a 100ms cap for cleanup but doesn't specify if this is wall-clock time or CPU time, which matters for network-mounted filesystems.
issues.fix: Specify 'wall-clock time' for the 100ms p95 cleanup budget.
